question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'minimising'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Minimising (Minimise + ing)** means to make something as small as possible (in amount or level).
